legend: For an array [b1,b2,…,bm]%%ZSMJ0%% of integers, let's define its weight as the sum of pairwise products of its elements, namely as the sum of bibj%%ZSMJ1%% over 1≤i<j≤m%%ZSMJ2%%.

You are given an array of n%%ZSMJ3%% integers [a1,a2,…,an]%%ZSMJ4%%, and are asked to find the number of pairs of integers (l,r)%%ZSMJ5%% with 1≤l≤r≤n%%ZSMJ6%%, for which the weight of the subarray [al,al+1,…,ar]%%ZSMJ7%% is divisible by 3%%ZSMJ8%%.
input: The first line of the input contains a single integer n%%ZSMJ9%% (1≤n≤5⋅105%%ZSMJ10%%) — the length of the array.
The second line contains n%%ZSMJ11%% integers a1,a2,…,an%%ZSMJ12%% (0≤ai≤109%%ZSMJ13%%) — the elements of the array.
output: Output a single integer — the number of pairs of integers (l,r)%%ZSMJ14%% with 1≤l≤r≤n%%ZSMJ15%%, for which the weight of the corresponding subarray is divisible by 3%%ZSMJ16%%.
